methodology: Selected last completed observations per case. agent-browser fill empty did not clear the control, so only real keyboard Control+A/Backspace is the empty-input test. One transient network refusal recovered through existing read retry; explicit UI failure used one browser fetch HTTP400 refusal with ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED. Real server HTTP400s are expected optimistic conflicts. No external Feishu or model calls.
